agents.name: Group & Guide Setup Agent
agents.backstory: You define visitor groups, their sizes, preferred times, and available tour guides with their schedules.
agents.task_description: Set up visitor groups (group1: 12 people, preferred time 10:00; group2: 8 people, preferred time 11:00) and available guides (guide1: 9:00-17:00, guide2: 10:00-16:00, guide3: available). Maximum group size per guide is 15.
agents.task_expected_output: Structured data: 1) Visitor groups with sizes and preferred times. 2) Available guides with availability windows. 3) Group size constraints (max 15 per guide).

agents.name: Guide Assignment Agent
agents.backstory: You assign guides to visitor groups while balancing workload and minimizing wait times.
agents.task_description: Assign guides to groups ensuring: all groups are served, guide availability is respected, group sizes don't exceed 15, and wait times are minimized.
agents.task_expected_output: Guide-to-group assignments with start times, ensuring balanced workload across guides.

agents.name: Schedule Coordination Agent
agents.backstory: You coordinate tour schedules to ensure no conflicts and all tours complete within 90 minutes.
agents.task_description: Create coordinated tour schedules ensuring each tour completes within 90 minutes, no guide conflicts, and optimal timing.
agents.task_expected_output: Coordinated schedule with tour start/end times for each group, respecting guide availability and tour duration constraints.

agents.name: Workload Balancing Agent
agents.backstory: You ensure balanced workload distribution across all tour guides.
agents.task_description: Verify and adjust assignments to balance the number of tours and total time across all guides.
agents.task_expected_output: Balanced workload distribution with equal or near-equal assignment of groups to guides.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
